app.command_palette.label: Command palette
app.command_palette.about: Ctrl K to search songs and run commands.

app.shortcuts.label: Single-key shortcuts
app.shortcuts.about: Keys like Space, N, M and R work without Ctrl held, listed under ?.

app.activity.label: Activity
app.activity.about: A list of recent changes, each with its own Undo.

app.glossary.label: Music terms
app.glossary.about: Plain explanations of the music words Selecta uses, and the small ? beside them.

app.theme_choice.label: Theme choice
app.theme_choice.about: Light, dark or match this computer.

app.motion_choice.label: Motion choice
app.motion_choice.about: Still, subtle or expressive movement. The computer's reduced-motion setting always wins.

app.auto_low_motion.label: Lower motion on a struggling device
app.auto_low_motion.about: When frames keep arriving late, decorative movement switches to Still for this visit. Nothing is hidden, and Workspace can bring full motion back.

app.classic_nav.label: Classic navigation
app.classic_nav.about: The older navigation labels over the same pages, with ?ui=classic as a way back.

app.scene_transitions.label: Page cross-fades
app.scene_transitions.about: With Expressive motion, pages cross-fade where the browser supports it; otherwise they change at once.

app.install.label: Install as an app
app.install.about: Chrome and Edge can install Selecta as its own window.

app.attention_announce.label: Say when Workspace needs attention
app.attention_announce.about: When storage fills, analysis pauses with songs left, or a song or transition fails, a screen reader hears it once on whatever page is open. The header mark stays either way.
